plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} worked hard, complained a little, and never once left someone behind. That's more than most of us can say.
I don't have the right words. {OTHER_nameDef} would have. That's the problem.
Every wall here has a little of {OTHER_nameDef} in it. We'll keep them standing.
{OTHER_nameDef} was here, with us. On the rim, that's everything.
[longtime] {YEARS} years. {OTHER_nameDef} was here for {YEARS} years. Most of what we have, {OTHER_nameDef} helped build.
[titled] We called {OTHER_nameDef} {TITLE}. It wasn't a joke. It was earned, every day.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL}. Didn't get the time. Some of us will try to finish it.
[battle] {FACTION} did this. {OTHER_nameDef} stood on the wall so the rest of us didn't have to. We won't forget that, and we won't forget them.
[battle] {OTHER_nameDef} died holding the line. Every one of us is alive because the line held.
[deadchild] There's nothing to say about a child in the ground. Nothing that helps. We'll remember the laughing.
[deadold] {OTHER_nameDef} saw more winters than any of us. Taught us how to get through them, too.
[kin] {OTHER_nameDef} was my family. Out here, family is the only thing you can't replace.
[partner] I woke up every day next to {OTHER_nameDef}. I don't know how to wake up any other way.
[stranger] I didn't know {OTHER_nameDef} well. I wish I had. That's the worst thing I can say, and it's true.
[rival] {OTHER_nameDef} and I fought about everything. I'd give a lot for one more argument.
[winter] We buried {OTHER_nameDef} in frozen ground. It took all of us. {OTHER_nameDef} would have liked that.
[rain] Even the sky is crying for {OTHER_nameDef}. Fitting. {OTHER_nameDef} was always dramatic.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made this place a home. Not a camp, not a fort. A home. Thank you, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[partner] I loved {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm going to keep saying it, out loud, so the rim knows.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL}. I'm going to try, for {OTHER_nameDef}.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was good at the job and good to the people around. Not much more to say. Not much more that matters.
[battle] {FACTION} took {OTHER_nameDef}. Next time they come, they'll find out what that cost them.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made me laugh every single day. I'm going to try to keep doing that for all of you. It won't be as good.

gloomy.li: We're all heading where {OTHER_nameDef} has gone. {OTHER_nameDef} just got there first, and left us the work.
[deadchild] We were supposed to keep the children safe. That was the whole point of all of this.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was reliable. Competent. Irreplaceable, in the literal sense. We are weaker today.
[battle] {OTHER_nameDef} fell to {FACTION}. I've added that to the ledger.
